forum.title: Can't compile code due to strange error messages : "expected declaration specifiers..."
forum.best_answer_content:
Dummy me!

I didn’t have the two Start calls inside a function. That also caused the #define error message.

Sometimes you can’t see the forest for the trees.
forum.author: Raymond Buck

scraped_replies.html: First guess is your “ADC_BUFFER” conflicts with something else named “ADC_BUFFER”.  Try renaming yours and see if you get different (!) error messages.  Good luck.
